amanda (PM): ok team — we need to synthesize the long-term platform roadmap for region routing + tenant isolation. customer asks flooding in, sales wants firm launch criteria by EoQ. high level proposal below.
priya (Arch): dropping the bullets would help. can we call out must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
amanda (PM): yep. must-have: per-tenant routing policy (latency SLO-driven), cross-region failover, data residency opt-in. nice-to-have: traffic-aware affinity, soft-eviction, per-tenant autoscale quotas.
jon (Eng): tech note: affinity implies more state (sticky allocation + KV cache affinity). cost and utilization hit unless we do adaptive packing.
lars (Infra): agree. packing + bin-packing lease allocator can reduce waste but adds complexity to allocation failures. need rollout plan.
chris (SRE): can we set measurable launch gates? e.g., 99th p95 latency uplift <= 20% for 95% of tenants; failover RPO < 60s; telemetry ready (per-tenant traces).
megan (Sales): customers pushing for deterministic latency for enterprise tier and contract language. they'll accept soft-eviction if there's a clear migration path.
priya (Arch): propose 3-phase rollout: 1) policy primitives + SLO routing (global fallback only), 2) tenant affinity lanes + cache affinity pilot, 3) geo-bound residency + opt-in controls.
amanda (PM): timeline sketch: phase1 = Q2 end (policy API + canary), phase2 = Q3 pilot with 3 customers, phase3 = Q4 GA for enterprise.
jon (Eng): technical blockers: kernel selection for cross-region kv-consistency, cost estimator for affinity overhead, and upgrade path for Dedicated clusters. need 6-sprint runway for phase2 pilot infra changes.
lars (Infra): and we need migration tooling: live-traffic shifting with rollback, per-tenant capacity reservation UI in console. otherwise ops burden too high.
chris (SRE): add automated chaos tests for failover and cold-cache scenarios. add synthetic tenants that'll spiky-test the canary.
megan (Sales): for pilot customers we'll need SLA language and pricing alternative for reserved affinity. sales can onboard 2-3 customers if we promise migration guarantees.
amanda (PM): decision points: 1) hard vs soft affinity default, 2) global fallback behavior (prefer low-latency vs prefer cost), 3) when to require Dedicated for residency. need alignment by next Thurs.
priya (Arch): suggested defaults: soft affinity by default, strict affinity opt-in; fallback prefers cost-for-lower-tier, latency-for-enterprise. keep residency requiring Dedicated until KMS/HSM in Private is validated.
jon (Eng): ack. I'll draft a short tech-spec with sequence diagrams and cost model.
lars (Infra): I'll scope the allocator changes and migration UI tasks; will include runbook for rollback paths.
chris (SRE): I'll own chaos tests + dashboards for canary.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-policy-service v0.1 -> canary (infra-1) at 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z
amanda (PM): next steps: jon + lars + chris produce PRD + runbook by Fri, priya + me review, megan to line up 2 pilot customers. we'll keep the doc minimal and attach acceptance criteria. thanks all :thumbsup:
